normalization_plan.reason: The token id parameter only exists to index the tulips array inside getTulip and has no independent semantic role
The token id parameter is only meaningful for the ownership check and name write inside nameArt
The name string parameter is directly consumed by the names mapping write in nameArt
The username parameter is directly stored by setUsername for the caller
The foundation id is consumed only by the commission flow of commissionArt
The inspiration id is consumed only by the commission flow of commissionArt
The genome parameter is forwarded only within the originalArtwork mint flow
The id parameter is used only to locate the tulip entry mutated by _creativeProcess
The genome parameter is only written into the Tulip struct constructed by _createTulip
The owner parameter is only used as the mint target inside _createTulip
The block hash seed local is transient state used solely to derive the genome in _creativeProcess
The derived genome local is a temporary accumulator written back by _creativeProcess
The new token id local is immediately consumed by the safe mint call in _createTulip
